phrase: Eight states are suing a chatbot maker over child safety. The same week, investigators arrested a worker there on espionage charges after finding a hidden recorder in a toilet-paper roll.
phraseAlternatives: Researchers showed how easily top AI image and chat tools can be pushed into making nonconsensual images or violent instructions.
A bankrupt chatbot company's own paperwork shows its business never really added up.
Before meeting a real client, some job applicants must first convince a fake AI one.
alt: A tall plain company building faces a short row of small courthouses, each topped with a tiny pink gavel icon. To the side, a guard leads a worried worker away from an empty table, where an ordinary toilet-paper roll with a small antenna sits alone, labeled "Hidden recorder found."

brief.concept: A chatbot maker faces lawsuits from eight state governments over child safety, and in the same week investigators arrest a worker there on espionage charges after finding a hidden recorder inside its offices.
brief.metaphor: Trouble comes from outside and inside at once: a line of courthouses knocks from the front while, deeper inside, an ordinary bathroom item turns out to hide a listener.

brief.composition: Left half: a plain tall company building with a row of small courthouse buildings lined up facing it like a queue, one gavel icon per courthouse. Right half: an empty conference room where a worker is being led out of frame by a security guard, while a toilet-paper roll with a tiny antenna sits alone on the table behind them. Keep shapes simple and flat; use the second ink color only on the antenna and the gavels to mark the joke.
brief.alt: A row of small courthouse buildings faces a large plain company building. Inside a meeting room on the other side, a worker is led out by a security guard while a toilet-paper roll with a tiny antenna sits alone on the table.
